استغفلا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْفَلَا (istaḡfalā) /is.taɣ.fa.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# اُسْتُغْفِلَا (ustuḡfilā) /us.tuɣ.fi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# اِسْتَغْفِلَا (istaḡfilā) /is.taɣ.fi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
